entities.summary: Chinwe Ohajuruka is a green Architect born in Nigerian. She divides her time between Nigeria and the United States for projects. She became the Sub-Saharan African Laureate for the Cartier Women's Initiative Awards in France in 2015 for her contribution in affordable green houses and social entrepreneurship. Chinwe Ohajuruka was a architects & engineers from Nigeria (b. 1960). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
